errors.problem: Requiring $\lambda$ above $\sigma$ and $\tau$ does not give the equality, since $\tau(1+c/\beta)>\tau$. The paper requires $\tau(1+c/\beta)<\lambda$, which also forces $c$ small enough that $\tau(1+c/\beta)<1$.

errors.quote: A chain passes through all $s$ children, not $s/W$ of them
errors.problem: The paper does not claim that every chain passes through all $s$ children. To get a conservative upper bound it concatenates all scalar gates and all $s$ calls of an invocation. The $1/W$ in the time recurrence came from the smaller stream volumes, not from a smaller number of children.
